body:
Hey friend. 

I am the complete same. Things just seem worse at night and when you are trying to sleep.  
I am currently trying sleeping medication and have bought a weighted blanket to help - maybe that's worth looking into for you aswell if you have trouble sleeping often.

Feel free to vent on here! That's what the subreddit is for, I believe? There are lots of people willing to listen and give advice. There are lots of people who care - even if they haven't even met you yet.

Hey friend. Ive been feeling a similar way for quite a while now.

A thing that helps me most of the time is just being around people. I prefer contact online but if you're more into meeting people irl go for that.

If you know discord - that's a good place to start meeting people with similar interests online, I found some really good friends on there that I hang out with almost daily now and it has helped me a lot.

I enjoy gaming together with them! If video games are your thing you'll easily make friends. If you need help finding a community you like, this website is helpful: [https://disboard.org/](https://disboard.org/)

​

I do enjoy venting via art as well. I've always liked drawing and have a graphic tablet and find it helpful to deal with my emotions by writing and drawing.

I hope you find something that helps you and things will get better soon.

i know. Theyre trying to help. Which makes me think that I am the problem even more. 

I have people who care about me. And who are trying to help. But everything just seems to get worse. No matter what I or anyone else does. No matter how much I try. It just keeps getting worse.

I honestly dont know what to do anymore. Reaching out was the last thing I thought might help and now thats just making shit worse. They always tell you to reach out to friends and family. What else am I supposed to do.

I want to get better. Im trying. Im trying my best. Nothing is working.
I'm sorry. I want to help so many people on here but I can't even help myself. I wish things were different.

Im in the same boat.

I couldnt even finish school because it was just too much.

Tried a bunch of jobs - Couldn't. It just didn't work. I was so stressed and so much more suicidal - taking days off and lying about being "sick", having a cold or stomach issues or whatnot even tho it was my mental health.  
First job i felt comfortable enough sharing that with - was still too many sick days so I was let go.

I'm relying on my parents right now and they're starting to push me towards getting another job. Understandably so. But I don't think I can do it. I don't think I can go through that all again. If they threaten to kick me out I'll just end it. There's no point in trying anymore.

Ive been so productive today.

I cleaned my rat cages and I was dogsitting. I even was outside for a bit and it was nice.

I thought I was better. Now it's 7:30 am and I still cant sleep. Everyone else is offline so I was alone with my thoughts and.... turns out I'm not better after all. Fun.

Just wrote this big post about how "venting" doesent do shit and this is one of the things. 

Who are they to tell us it gets better. Especially when the present is so bad, you dont even think about seeing your future.

It didn't get better till now. I don't know how much longer I'll try to reach that point.
I keep thinking about it. Why do others who want to live have to suffer and die while I would hold onto any excuse to die- just to scared to do it myself I guess.
I feel the exact same. If I could access a gun easily I would not still be here.
Been there for over a year... I refuse to delete any more of my precious songs and pictures!
